gallery.source: Giant Rock in Landers, CA July 2008
gallery.description:
The Giant Rock nearby Landers, CA.  
The fragment in the foreground broke off from the main boulder on February 23, 2000, due to unknown causes.
The concrete pad is a former restaurant building that was part of the Giant Rock Airport that was leased from the U.S. Government by George Van Tassel and his family during the late 1950's thru the 1970's.
The Giant Rock stands about 7 stories tall and is the largest freestanding boulder in North America.
categories: Nature of San Bernardino County, California
